text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I won!
See, didn't I tell you!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
Fufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I did iiiiiiit!!
choice_data_list: Congratulations...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing her burst with joy, the tension finally left my body. She had successfully decorated her debut race with a victory.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hey, real "races" are amazing!
They're totally different from mock races or exhibition events!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: The tension is amazing, and the spirit of the girls around me is on another level! I can feel how serious everyone is...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the best part of all...
is the joy after blowing past the finish line!
Heheh, hehehehe..."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa there.
choice_data_list: Are you okay?!
Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...I-I'm okay...
Though maybe I should sit down...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Almond Eye sat and caught her breath, I gave her an icing treatment and other care.
She seemed to calm down a bit after a while, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
...I never thought I'd get this exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If it were just a mock race, a light jog
afterwards would have been fine, but...
choice_data_list: You should take a few days off to rest.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she said earlier,
many factors compound during an actual race,
making it vastly more exhausting than mock races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On top of that, Eye's strong desire to win pushes her body beyond its limits... leaving her far more exhausted than necessary.
choice_data_list: (I need to talk to her about our future goals.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once she had completely recovered
and could finally go outside, I brought up the topic.
choice_data_list: It's our target race, but how about pushing it to next year?
It's our target race, but should we save it for next year?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
!
Does that mean you won't be racing for a while?
choice_data_list: Of course I'll be there if the timing works out, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running grueling races while her body hasn't
caught up to her mindset is dangerous.
If so, our first goal should be building her physique.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It becomes even more crucial—
in order to enter next year's Classic and subsequent Senior years fully prepared.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...If you're saying that,
does that mean you already have a target race in mind?"
choice_data_list: I'll decide that after I hear what path you're aiming for.
I'll decide that after hearing what path you want to take.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: The path I aim for...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are many paths to take in the Twinkle Series.
The Classic Triple Crown, the Tiara route, the Mile route...
While aptitudes play a part in deciding which way to go—
choice_data_list: If it's you, you can forge any path...!
If it's you, you can forge any path...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I don't understand!
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry!
It's just, my heart isn't moved yet!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run in races where I feel,
'I want to race against her!' or
'This is the race for me!'"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: It's precisely because you desire it with all your heart! That's what makes winning so utterly delightful.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"So I don't know! Would you mind
asking me next year how I'll move forward?"
choice_data_list: ...Got it! That said—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
We really need to set a target, don't we?
It affects our training policy, after all...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
What kind of race
do you think would be best?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Asked for my thoughts, I consider our options. In this case, rather than a race directly tied to a specific route, something that leads to more possibilities—
choice_data_list: What do you think about the GⅢ Shinzan Kinen?
How about the GⅢ race, the Shinzan Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The "Shinzan Kinen"...
That's held in early January, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Agreed! It's a mile race, so it's a distance that works regardless of which path you take—
choice_data_list: I can take on anyone, whether they're aiming for the Triple Crown or the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes, it lets you test your strength across the board. Plus, there's plenty of time before the Oka Sho and Satsuki Sho. No impact on the rotation!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "So we'll build up your body until the Shinzan Kinen while entering races that fit your schedule... That's the plan."
choice_data_list: I might not be able to enter many races, but...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ugh... It can't be helped! When I really think about it, I'm not the dexterous type anyway...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If you want to focus on what's in front of you—
on your training first—that's totally fine!
It just means next year will be even more fun, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, of course!
Yeah, of course!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's a deal!
Give me a routine that'll make me grow like crazy, got it?
choice_data_list: ...I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Heeeee~~~~y!
Ai~~~!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, were you waiting for me?
We could've just met in our room!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Because, because, I wanted to tell you right away!
You were aaa-mazing, Ai!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Zooming all the way to the goal in the blink of an eye!
Congrats! You looked so cool!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you!
It's your turn next—I'll be there to cheer you on!
choice_data_list: (She's got good friends.)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh? That girl was in today's Make Debut...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye. That was a magnificent run.
Above all else, you are overflowing with potential.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This year, once again, dazzling talent has gathered in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What will they leave behind
in the racing world, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe someone will even leap right over
the line you've etched out for them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, couldn't ask for better.
All records exist to be broken—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Because a brighter future lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few weeks after the Make Debut,
we had arranged a mock race for today. Now that she's
experienced a real race, it's time to sharpen her senses even further.
choice_data_list: Your ability is a cut above the rest, but...
Your ability is a cut above the rest, but...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'll give it everything I've got!
—I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "However... the result was second place. Almond Eye lost—all because of a late start."
